clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge's Tinker Town, Lomac Gearstrip pursues gnomish inventions. He formulated the NG-5 explosive and keeps in contact with fellow researchers in Kalimdor.

Lomac Gearstrip works on gnomish ordnance in Ironforge's Tinker Town. Like many gnomes who fled Gnomeregan's tragedy, he has brought his tinkering operations to the dwarven capital. His workshop focuses on volatile chemical mixtures and specialized munitions meant to overcome heavily defended enemy strongholds.

Lomac's proudest contribution to combat engineering is the NG-5 explosive. The compound is made for maximum destructive yield and requires precise handling and rare chemical reagents. To refine and use such hazardous inventions in the field, Lomac stays in contact with former colleagues stationed in distant theaters. They exchange technical orders and dangerous supplies across the Great Sea.
